mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary policy, boosting equity markets by reducing borrowing costs.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 1% but SPX shows negative returns over 60 days in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment and low interest rates indicate a strong economy, leading to increased consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: UNRATE and FEDFUNDS remain low but SPX returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production suggests strong economic activity, leading to higher equity prices.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth exceeds 2% YoY but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, boosting equities.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains low but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of 5-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts indicate strong demand in the housing market, leading to increased economic activity and positive equity returns.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 1150 but SPX returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales and low interest rates indicate strong consumer demand and easy borrowing, boosting equity markets.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth and low FEDFUNDS occur but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate in a late-cycle expansion indicates potential economic slowdown, leading to negative equity returns.
